tools.name: nl_home_basic
tools.description: Free. Facts about a Dutch address in English: year built, floor area, use, neighbourhood residents and average home value, Leefbaarometer liveability percentile. Sources: BAG, CBS, Leefbaarometer.

tools.name: nl_vehicle_basic
tools.description: Free. Dutch licence plate → make, model, age, fuel, Euro class, APK (MOT) expiry, insurance, open recall, RDW odometer verdict, risk level. Source: RDW.

tools.name: nl_neighbourhood_summary
tools.description: Free. Headline facts about a Dutch neighbourhood for a postcode: residents, average home value, share of owner-occupied homes, liveability percentile, crime per 1,000 residents vs the national rate, and distance to supermarket, GP, primary school and train station. Sources: CBS, Politie, Leefbaarome

tools.name: nl_car_model
tools.description: Free. Reliability facts for a car model in the Netherlands from RDW data: APK (MOT) defect rate vs the average of all models, the 10 most common APK defects, recalls with component and risk, share with an open recall, share with an illogical (rolled-back) odometer, cars registered. Covers ~450 commo

tools.name: nl_schools_near
tools.description: Free. The nearest primary and secondary schools to a Dutch postcode, with distance, denomination, pupils, the share of pupils reaching the target reading and maths level on the end-of-primary test (vs national), and secondary exam pass rates per track (vmbo/havo/vwo). Source: DUO open data.

tools.name: nl_home_report
tools.description: Dutch address report in English: year built, floor area, use; neighbourhood people, home values, income; 18 amenity distances; crime vs national rate; listed monuments; permits nearby; ground height; noise and air quality (NO2, PM2.5); liveability. Input: postcode + house number. Sources: BAG, CBS,

tools.name: nl_home_compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 Dutch addresses in one call, in English: liveability, police-registered crime, average home value, floor area, year built, distances to train station, supermarket, primary school and GP, noise, air quality and ground height, plus the best address per metric and the full report for eac

tools.name: nl_neighbourhood
tools.description: Dutch neighbourhood profile in English for any postcode or CBS neighbourhood code: residents and age mix, housing and home values, income, energy use, distances to 18 amenities, police-registered crime vs the national rate, and Leefbaarometer liveability. No exact address needed. Sources: CBS, Polit

tools.name: nl_vehicle_report
tools.description: Dutch licence plate check in English: make, model, APK (MOT) expiry, insurance, open recalls with details, RDW odometer verdict, full APK inspection history with defects found, import/taxi/export history, specs, power, CO2, catalogue price, and risk flags. Input: Dutch licence plate. Source: RDW ope
